units.Ezekiel 33:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 33:2: “Son of man, speak to your people’s sons and say to them, ‘If I bring a sword upon a land, and the land’s people take one man from among themselves and appoint him as their watchman,
units.Ezekiel 33:3: and he sees the sword coming upon the land, sounds the trumpet and signals to the people,
units.Ezekiel 33:4: and a hearer hears the trumpet’s sound but does not take care, and the sword comes upon him and overtakes him, his blood will be upon his own head.
units.Ezekiel 33:5: Because he heard the trumpet’s sound and did not take care, his blood will be upon himself. But this one, because he took care, rescued his life.
units.Ezekiel 33:6: If the watchman sees the sword coming but does not signal with the trumpet, and the people do not take care, and the sword comes and takes a life from them, that life was taken because of its own lawlessness, but I will require the blood from the watchman’s hand.’
units.Ezekiel 33:7: And you, son of man, I have appointed you a watchman for Israel’s house, and you will hear a word from My mouth.
units.Ezekiel 33:8: When I say to the sinner, ‘You will surely be put to death,’ and you do not speak so that the impious man may guard himself from his way, that lawless man will die in his lawlessness, but I will require his blood from your hand.
units.Ezekiel 33:9: But if you forewarn the impious man of his way so that he may turn from it and he does not turn from his way, this man will die in his impiety, and you have rescued your own life.
units.Ezekiel 33:10: And you, son of man, say to Israel’s house, ‘You spoke this way: Our wanderings and lawless deeds are upon us, and we waste away in them. How shall we live?’
units.Ezekiel 33:11: Say to them, ‘I live, thus says the Lord: I do not desire the impious man’s death, but rather that he turn from his way and live. Turn back completely from your way! Why are you dying, house of Israel?’
units.Ezekiel 33:12: Say to your people’s sons, ‘A righteous man’s righteousness certainly will not rescue him on the day he wanders, and an impious man’s lawlessness certainly will not harm him on the day he turns from it. A righteous man certainly will not be able to be saved.
units.Ezekiel 33:13: When I speak to the righteous man—this one has trusted in his righteousness, yet commits lawlessness—none of his righteous deeds will ever be remembered. In the injustice he committed, in it he will die.
units.Ezekiel 33:14: When I say to the impious man, “You will surely be put to death,” and he turns from his sin and practices judgment and righteousness,
units.Ezekiel 33:15: and returns a pledge, repays what he seized and walks in the ordinances of life without doing wrong, he will surely live and certainly will not die.
units.Ezekiel 33:16: None of the sins he committed will ever be remembered, because he practiced judgment and righteousness; in these he will live.
units.Ezekiel 33:17: Your people’s sons will say, “The Lord’s way is not straight.” Yet this way of theirs is not straight.
units.Ezekiel 33:18: When a righteous man turns from his righteousness and commits lawless deeds, he will die in them.
units.Ezekiel 33:19: When the sinner turns from his lawlessness and practices judgment and righteousness, in these he will live.
units.Ezekiel 33:20: This is what you said: “The Lord’s way is not straight.” I will judge you, each in his ways, house of Israel.’”
units.Ezekiel 33:21: In the twelfth year of our captivity, in the twelfth month, on the fifth of the month, the survivor from Jerusalem came to me, saying, “The city has been captured!”
units.Ezekiel 33:22: The Lord’s hand came upon me in the evening before he arrived, and He opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning. Once my mouth was opened, it was no longer restrained.
units.Ezekiel 33:23: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 33:24: “Son of man, those dwelling in the devastated places upon Israel’s land say, ‘Abraham was one, yet he possessed the land. We are more; the land has been given to us as a possession.’
units.Ezekiel 33:25: Therefore say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
units.Ezekiel 33:27: I live: surely those in the devastated places will fall by the sword. Those in the open plain will be given as food to the field’s beasts, and those in fortified places and caves I will kill with death.
units.Ezekiel 33:28: I will make the land a wilderness; the arrogance of her strength will perish, and Israel’s mountains will be desolate because no one passes through.
units.Ezekiel 33:29: They will know that I am the Lord. I will make their land a wilderness, and it will be desolate because of all the abominations they committed.’
units.Ezekiel 33:30: And you, son of man, your people’s sons talk about you beside the walls and in the houses’ gateways. A man says to his brother, ‘Let us gather and hear what comes from the Lord!’
units.Ezekiel 33:31: They come to you as people assemble and sit before you. They hear your words but certainly will not do them, because falsehood is in their mouth, and their heart follows defilements.
units.Ezekiel 33:32: You become to them like the sound of a sweet-voiced, well-tuned psaltery. They will hear your words but certainly will not do them.
units.Ezekiel 33:33: When it comes, they will say, ‘Behold, it has arrived,’ and know that a prophet was among them.”
units.Ezekiel 34:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 34:2: “Son of man, prophesy against Israel’s shepherds. Prophesy and say to the shepherds, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: O shepherds of Israel, surely shepherds do not feed themselves? Do shepherds not feed the sheep?
units.Ezekiel 34:3: Behold, you consume the milk, clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the fattened animal, but you do not feed My sheep.
units.Ezekiel 34:4: You have not strengthened the weak, restored the sick to health, bound up the broken, brought back the wandering or sought the lost. You have worn down the strong with toil.
units.Ezekiel 34:5: My sheep scattered because there were no shepherds and became food for all the field’s beasts.
units.Ezekiel 34:6: My sheep scattered on every mountain and upon every high hill, and scattered over the whole face of the earth. There was no one seeking them out or turning them back.
units.Ezekiel 34:7: Therefore, shepherds, hear the Lord’s word:
units.Ezekiel 34:8: I live, says the Lord, the Lord: surely because My sheep became plunder and My sheep became food for all the plain’s beasts for lack of shepherds, and the shepherds did not seek out My sheep but fed themselves and did not feed My sheep—
units.Ezekiel 34:10: thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against the shepherds. I will require My sheep from their hands and turn them aside from shepherding My sheep. The shepherds will no longer feed them. I will rescue My sheep from their mouth, and they will no longer be food for them.
units.Ezekiel 34:11: For thus says the Lord: Behold, I will seek out My sheep and visit them.
units.Ezekiel 34:12: As a shepherd seeks his flock on a day when there is gloom and cloud among separated sheep, so I will seek out My sheep and drive them away from every place where they scattered on a day of cloud and gloom.
units.Ezekiel 34:13: I will bring them out from the nations, gather them from the countries and bring them into their own land. I will feed them upon Israel’s mountains, in the ravines and in every dwelling place of the land.
units.Ezekiel 34:14: I will feed them in good pasture, and their folds will be upon Israel’s high mountain. There they will lie down, there rest in good delight, and graze in rich pasture upon Israel’s mountains.
units.Ezekiel 34:15: I Myself will feed My sheep and give them rest, and they will know that I am the Lord. Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
units.Ezekiel 34:16: I will seek the lost, bring back the wandering, bind up the broken, strengthen the failing and guard the strong. I will feed them with judgment.
units.Ezekiel 34:17: And you, sheep, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I will distinguish between sheep and sheep, rams and male goats.
units.Ezekiel 34:18: Was it not enough for you that you grazed the good pasture, yet trampled the rest of your pasture with your feet, drank the settled water and troubled the rest with your feet?
units.Ezekiel 34:19: My sheep grazed what your feet had trampled and drank the water troubled by your feet.
units.Ezekiel 34:20: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I will distinguish between the strong sheep and the weak sheep.
units.Ezekiel 34:21: You shove with your sides and shoulders; you butted with your horns and forced out every failing one.
units.Ezekiel 34:22: I will save My sheep, and they certainly will no longer be plunder. I will judge between ram and ram.
units.Ezekiel 34:23: I will raise up one shepherd over them, My servant David, and he will shepherd them and be their shepherd.
units.Ezekiel 34:24: I, the Lord, will be their God, and David a ruler among them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
units.Ezekiel 34:25: I will make a covenant of peace with David and remove harmful beasts from the land. They will dwell in the wilderness and sleep in the woods.
units.Ezekiel 34:26: I will place them around My mountain and give you rain, rain of blessing.
units.Ezekiel 34:27: The trees in the plain will give their fruit, and the land will give its strength. They will dwell upon their land in hope of peace and know that I am the Lord when I shatter their yoke. I will rescue them from the hand of those who enslaved them.
units.Ezekiel 34:28: They will no longer be plunder for the nations, and the land’s beasts certainly will no longer eat them. They will dwell in hope, and no one will terrify them.
units.Ezekiel 34:29: I will raise up a plant of peace for them. They will no longer perish by famine upon the land or bear the nations’ reproach.
units.Ezekiel 34:30: They will know that I am the Lord their God, and they, Israel’s house, are My people, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 34:31: You are My sheep and the sheep of My flock, and I am the Lord your God, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 35:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 35:2: “Son of man, turn your face toward Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
units.Ezekiel 35:3: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Mount Seir. I will stretch My hand against you and make you a wilderness, and you will be laid waste.
units.Ezekiel 35:4: I will make your cities desolate, and you will be a wilderness. You will know that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 35:5: Because you became an everlasting enemy and ambushed Israel’s house treacherously, by enemies’ hand, with a sword at the final time of injustice,
units.Ezekiel 35:6: therefore, I live, says the Lord, the Lord: surely you sinned unto blood, and blood will pursue you.
units.Ezekiel 35:7: I will make Mount Seir a wilderness and lay it waste, and destroy human beings and livestock from it,
units.Ezekiel 35:8: and fill the hills and your ravines with your wounded. In all your plains, those wounded by the sword will fall within you.
units.Ezekiel 35:9: I will make you an everlasting wilderness, and your cities certainly will not be inhabited again. You will know that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 35:10: Because you said, “The two nations and the two countries will be mine, and I will inherit them,” and the Lord is there,
units.Ezekiel 35:11: therefore, I live, says the Lord: I will deal with you according to your hostility and make Myself known to you when I judge you.
units.Ezekiel 35:12: You will know that I am the Lord. I heard the voice of your blasphemies, because you said, “Israel’s mountains are desolate; they have been given to us for food.”
units.Ezekiel 35:13: You spoke grandly against Me with your mouth. I heard.
units.Ezekiel 35:14: Thus says the Lord: In the rejoicing of the whole earth, I will make you a wilderness.
units.Ezekiel 35:15: You will be a wilderness, Mount Seir, and all Idumea will be utterly consumed. You will know that I am the Lord their God.’”
units.Ezekiel 36:1: “And you, son of man, prophesy concerning Israel’s mountains and say to Israel’s mountains, ‘Hear the Lord’s word:
units.Ezekiel 36:2: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because the enemy said over you, “Well done! Everlasting wildernesses have become our possession,”
units.Ezekiel 36:3: therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because you were dishonored and hated by those around you, so that you became a possession for the remaining nations, and you became a topic on people’s tongues and a reproach to nations,
units.Ezekiel 36:4: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord to the mountains, hills, ravines, torrents, devastated and destroyed places, and abandoned cities, which became plunder and a trampling place for the remaining nations all around:
units.Ezekiel 36:5: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Surely in the fire of My wrath I have spoken against the remaining nations and all Idumea, because they gave My land to themselves as a possession with rejoicing, dishonoring lives so as to destroy through plunder.
units.Ezekiel 36:6: Therefore prophesy over Israel’s land and say to the mountains, hills, ravines and valleys, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I have spoken in My jealousy and My wrath because you bore the nations’ reproaches.
units.Ezekiel 36:7: Therefore I will raise My hand against the nations around you; these will receive their own dishonor.
units.Ezekiel 36:8: But your grapes and fruit, mountains of Israel, My people will consume, for they are drawing near.
units.Ezekiel 36:9: For behold, I am toward you; I will look upon you, and you will be cultivated and sown.
units.Ezekiel 36:10: I will multiply people upon you, all Israel’s house completely. The cities will be inhabited and the devastated land rebuilt.
units.Ezekiel 36:11: I will multiply humans and livestock upon you, settle you as at your beginning and do you good as in your former times. You will know that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 36:12: I will cause people, My people Israel, to be born upon you. They will inherit you, and you will be their possession. You certainly will no longer be bereaved of them.
units.Ezekiel 36:13: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Because they said to you, “You devour human beings and became bereaved by your nation,”
units.Ezekiel 36:14: therefore you will no longer eat human beings or bereave your nation, says the Lord, the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 36:15: The nations’ dishonor will no longer be heard against you, and you certainly will not bear the peoples’ reproaches, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 36:16: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 36:17: “Son of man, Israel’s house lived upon their land and defiled it by their way, their idols and their uncleannesses. Their way before Me became like the uncleanness of a woman sitting apart.
units.Ezekiel 36:18: I poured My wrath upon them
units.Ezekiel 36:19: and scattered them among the nations and winnowed them into the countries. I judged them according to their way and their sin.
units.Ezekiel 36:20: They entered the nations where they entered, and profaned My holy name when it was said of them, ‘These are the Lord’s people, and they have left His land.’
units.Ezekiel 36:21: I spared them because of My holy name, which Israel’s house profaned among the nations where they entered.
units.Ezekiel 36:22: Therefore say to Israel’s house, ‘Thus says the Lord: I am not acting for you, house of Israel, but because of My holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you entered.
units.Ezekiel 36:23: I will sanctify My great name, profaned among the nations, which you profaned among them. The nations will know that I am the Lord when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.
units.Ezekiel 36:24: I will take you out of the nations, gather you out of all the lands and bring you into your own land.
units.Ezekiel 36:25: I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will be cleansed from all your uncleannesses and all your idols. I will cleanse you.
units.Ezekiel 36:26: And I will give you a new heart, and I will give a new spirit within you; and I will take the heart of stone out of your flesh, and give you a heart of flesh.
units.Ezekiel 36:27: I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My ordinances, keep My judgments and do them.
units.Ezekiel 36:28: You will dwell upon the land I gave your fathers. You will be My people, and I will be your God.
units.Ezekiel 36:29: I will save you from all your uncleannesses, summon the grain and multiply it, and will not bring famine upon you.
units.Ezekiel 36:30: I will multiply the tree’s fruit and the field’s produce, so that you do not bear the reproach of famine among the nations.
units.Ezekiel 36:31: You will remember your evil ways and practices that were not good, and feel disgust before them at your lawless deeds and abominations.
units.Ezekiel 36:32: I am not acting because of you, says the Lord, the Lord; this will be known to you. Be ashamed and abashed because of your ways, house of Israel.
units.Ezekiel 36:33: Thus says the Lord: On the day I cleanse you from all your lawless deeds, I will cause the cities to be inhabited, and the wilderness places will be rebuilt.
units.Ezekiel 36:34: The devastated land will be worked, instead of lying devastated before every passerby’s eyes.
units.Ezekiel 36:35: They will say, “That devastated land has become like a garden of delight, and the deserted, devastated, razed cities stand fortified.”
units.Ezekiel 36:36: The nations remaining around you will know that I, the Lord, have rebuilt the razed places and planted the devastated places. I, the Lord, have spoken and will act.
units.Ezekiel 36:37: Thus says the Lord: I will also be sought by Israel’s house to do this for them: I will multiply them, human beings like sheep.
units.Ezekiel 36:38: Like holy sheep, like Jerusalem’s sheep at her festivals, so the deserted cities will be filled with sheep who are human beings. They will know that I am the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 37:1: The Lord’s hand came upon me. The Lord brought me out in spirit and set me in the middle of the plain, which was full of human bones.
units.Ezekiel 37:2: He led me all around them, and behold, there were very many upon the plain’s surface, very dry.
units.Ezekiel 37:3: He said to me, ‘Son of man, will these bones live?’ I said, ‘Lord, Thou knowest these things.’
units.Ezekiel 37:4: He said to me, ‘Prophesy over these bones and say to them, Dry bones, hear the Lord’s word:
units.Ezekiel 37:5: Thus says the Lord to these bones: Behold, I am bringing the breath of life into you,
units.Ezekiel 37:6: and I will put sinews upon you, bring flesh upon you, stretch skin over you and put My Spirit into you. You will live and know that I am the Lord.’
units.Ezekiel 37:7: I prophesied as He commanded me. As I prophesied, behold, there was a shaking, and the bones came together, each to its joint.
units.Ezekiel 37:8: I saw, and behold, sinews and flesh grew upon them, and skin came up over them, but there was no breath in them.
units.Ezekiel 37:9: He said to me, ‘Prophesy, son of man! Prophesy to the breath and say to the breath, Thus says the Lord: Come from the four winds and breathe into these dead, and let them live!’
units.Ezekiel 37:10: I prophesied as He commanded me. The breath entered them, and they lived and stood upon their feet, an exceedingly great assembly.
units.Ezekiel 37:11: The Lord spoke to me, saying, ‘Son of man, these bones are all Israel’s house, and they say, Our bones have become dry, our hope has perished; we are utterly spent.
units.Ezekiel 37:12: Therefore prophesy and say, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am opening your tombs and will bring you up from your tombs and into Israel’s land,
units.Ezekiel 37:13: and you will know that I am the Lord when I open your graves to bring My people up from the graves.
units.Ezekiel 37:14: I will put My Spirit into you, and you will live. I will place you upon your land, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken and will act, says the Lord.’
units.Ezekiel 37:15: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 37:16: ‘Son of man, take a staff for yourself and write upon it Judah and Israel’s sons attached to him. Take a second staff for yourself and write upon it, For Joseph—Ephraim’s staff—and all Israel’s sons joined to him.
units.Ezekiel 37:17: Join them to one another for yourself as one staff, binding them together, and they will be in your hand.
units.Ezekiel 37:18: When your people’s sons say to you, Will you not tell us what these things mean to you?
units.Ezekiel 37:19: say to them, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I will take Joseph’s tribe through Ephraim’s hand, and Israel’s tribes attached to him, and place them upon Judah’s tribe. They will become one staff in Judah’s hand.
units.Ezekiel 37:20: The staffs upon which you wrote will be in your hand before them,
units.Ezekiel 37:21: and say to them, Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am taking all Israel’s house from among the nations where they entered, gathering them from all those around them and bringing them into Israel’s land.
units.Ezekiel 37:22: I will make them one nation in My land and upon Israel’s mountains, and one ruler will be theirs. They will no longer be two nations or ever again be divided into two kingdoms,
units.Ezekiel 37:23: so that they no longer defile themselves with their idols. I will deliver them from all their lawless deeds in which they sinned and cleanse them. They will be My people, and I, the Lord, will be their God.
units.Ezekiel 37:24: My servant David will be ruler among them, and one shepherd will be over all, because they will walk in My ordinances, keep My judgments and do them.
units.Ezekiel 37:25: They will dwell upon their land, which I gave My servant Jacob, where their fathers dwelt. They will dwell upon it, and David My servant will be their ruler for ever.
units.Ezekiel 37:26: I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant with them. I will set My holy things among them for ever.
units.Ezekiel 37:27: My dwelling will be among them. I will be their God, and they will be My people.
units.Ezekiel 37:28: The nations will know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them, when My holy things are among them for ever.’
units.Ezekiel 38:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 38:2: “Son of man, set your face firmly against Gog and the land of Magog, ruler of Rhos, Mosoch and Thobel, and prophesy against him,
units.Ezekiel 38:3: and say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Rhos, Mosoch and Thobel,
units.Ezekiel 38:4: and I will gather you and all your force, horses and horsemen all clothed in breastplates, a great assembly, small shields, helmets and swords,
units.Ezekiel 38:5: Persians, Ethiopians and Libyans, all with helmets and small shields;
units.Ezekiel 38:6: Gomer and all those around him, the house of Thergama from the farthest north and all those around him, and many nations with you.
units.Ezekiel 38:7: Be made ready; prepare yourself, you and all your assembly gathered with you, and you will be a guard for Me.
units.Ezekiel 38:8: After many days he will be prepared, and at the end of years he will come and reach the land turned back from the sword, of those gathered from many nations, upon Israel’s land that had been wholly desolate. This one has come out of nations, and all will dwell in peace.
units.Ezekiel 38:9: You will come up like rain and arrive like a cloud to cover the land; you will be there, with all those around you and many nations with you.
units.Ezekiel 38:10: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: On that day words will rise in your heart, and you will devise evil plans,
units.Ezekiel 38:11: and say, “I will go up against an abandoned land; I will come upon those resting quietly and dwelling in peace, all living in a land with no wall or bars, and they have no doors,”
units.Ezekiel 38:12: to take plunder and strip their spoils, to turn your hand against the desolate land that was inhabited and against a nation gathered from many nations, acquiring possessions, dwelling upon the earth’s navel.
units.Ezekiel 38:13: Saba, Daidan, Carthaginian merchants and all their villages will say to you, “Are you coming for plunder, to plunder and strip spoils? Have you gathered your assembly to take silver and gold, carry away possessions and strip spoils?”
units.Ezekiel 38:14: Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, Thus says the Lord: On that day when My people Israel are settled in peace, will you not be roused?
units.Ezekiel 38:15: You will come from your place in the farthest north, with many nations beside you, all horse riders, a great assembly and a mighty force,
units.Ezekiel 38:16: and come up against My people Israel like a cloud covering the land. It will be at the end of days; I will bring you against My land so that all the nations may know Me when I am sanctified in you before them.
units.Ezekiel 38:17: Thus says the Lord, the Lord, to Gog: You are the one of whom I spoke before the former days through My servants, Israel’s prophets, in those days and years, to bring you against them.
units.Ezekiel 38:18: On that day, on the day Gog comes against Israel’s land, says the Lord, the Lord, My wrath will rise,
units.Ezekiel 38:19: and My jealousy. In the fire of My anger I have spoken: Surely on that day there will be a great shaking upon Israel’s land,
units.Ezekiel 38:20: and the sea’s fish, the sky’s birds, the plain’s beasts, every creeping thing upon the earth and every human upon the earth’s face will shake before the Lord. The mountains will split, the ravines will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.
units.Ezekiel 38:21: I will summon every fear against him, says the Lord. A man’s sword will be against his brother.
units.Ezekiel 38:22: I will judge him with death, blood, flooding rain and hailstones. I will rain fire and sulfur upon him, all those with him and the many nations with him.
units.Ezekiel 38:23: I will be magnified, sanctified, glorified and made known before many nations, and they will know that I am the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 39:1: “And you, son of man, prophesy against Gog and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am against you, Gog, ruler of Rhos, Mosoch and Thobel,
units.Ezekiel 39:2: and I will gather you, lead you along, bring you up from the farthest north and bring you upon Israel’s mountains.
units.Ezekiel 39:3: I will destroy your bow from your left hand and your arrows from your right hand, and strike you down
units.Ezekiel 39:4: upon Israel’s mountains. You and all those around you will fall, and the nations with you will be given to multitudes of birds. I have given you to every flying creature and all the plain’s beasts to be eaten.
units.Ezekiel 39:5: Upon the open plain you will fall, for I have spoken, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 39:6: I will send fire upon Gog, and the islands will be inhabited in peace. They will know that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 39:7: My holy name will be known among My people Israel and My holy name will no longer be profaned. The nations will know that I am the Lord, holy in Israel.
units.Ezekiel 39:8: Behold, it has arrived, and you will know that it will be, says the Lord, the Lord. This is the day on which I spoke.
units.Ezekiel 39:9: Those dwelling in Israel’s cities will go out and burn fires with the weapons: small shields, pikes, bows, arrows, hand staffs and spears. They will burn fires with them for seven years.
units.Ezekiel 39:10: They certainly will not take wood from the plain or cut it from the woods; they will burn the weapons with fire. They will plunder those who plundered them and strip those who stripped them, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 39:11: On that day I will give Gog a notable place, a memorial tomb in Israel, the mass grave of those who came against it, beside the sea. They will build around the valley’s mouth and bury Gog and all his multitude there. It will be called Gai, Gog’s Mass Grave.
units.Ezekiel 39:12: Israel’s house will bury them over seven months so that the land may be cleansed.
units.Ezekiel 39:13: All the land’s people will bury them, and it will bring them renown on the day I was glorified, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 39:14: They will continually designate men to pass through the land and bury those left upon the land’s surface, to cleanse it after the seven months, and they will search.
units.Ezekiel 39:15: Everyone passing through the land who sees a human bone will build a marker beside it until the buriers bury it in Gai, Gog’s Mass Grave.
units.Ezekiel 39:16: Indeed, the city’s name will be Mass Grave, and the land will be cleansed.
units.Ezekiel 39:17: And you, son of man, say, Thus says the Lord: Say to every flying bird and all the plain’s beasts, Gather and come! Gather from all those around to My sacrifice that I have sacrificed for you, a great sacrifice upon Israel’s mountains. You will eat flesh and drink blood.
units.Ezekiel 39:18: You will eat giants’ flesh and drink the blood of the land’s rulers: rams, calves and male goats, and the calves all fattened.
units.Ezekiel 39:19: You will eat fat to fullness and drink blood to drunkenness from My sacrifice that I sacrificed for you.
units.Ezekiel 39:20: At My table you will be filled with horse and rider, giant and every warrior, says the Lord.

units.Numbers 17:17: Speak to the sons of Israel and take from them one staff for each ancestral house, from all their leaders according to their ancestral houses—twelve staffs. Write each man’s name on his staff.
units.Numbers 17:18: And write Aaron’s name on Levi’s staff, for they shall give one staff for each tribe of their ancestral houses.
units.Numbers 17:19: And you shall place them in the Tent of Testimony, opposite the testimony, where I will make Myself known unto you.
units.Numbers 17:20: And the staff of the man I choose shall sprout. I will remove from Myself the sons of Israel’s grumbling, which they direct against you.

units.Numbers 17:22: And Moses placed the staffs before the Lord in the Tent of Testimony.
units.Numbers 17:23: And the next day Moses and Aaron entered the Tent of Testimony, and there Aaron’s staff for the house of Levi had sprouted: it brought forth a shoot, flowered with blossoms, and produced nuts.
units.Numbers 17:24: And Moses brought all the staffs out from before the Lord to all the sons of Israel. They looked, and each man took his staff.
units.Numbers 17:25: And the Lord said unto Moses: Put Aaron’s staff before the testimonies, to be kept as a sign for the sons of the disobedient. Let their grumbling against Me cease, and they shall certainly not die.
units.Numbers 17:26: And Moses and Aaron did so. Just as the Lord commanded Moses, so they did.

units.Ezekiel 17:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 17:2: “Son of man, tell a story and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
units.Ezekiel 17:3: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: The great eagle, with great wings and a broad span, full of talons, which has authority to enter Lebanon, took the cedar’s choice parts;
units.Ezekiel 17:4: he nipped off the tips of its tender growth, carried them to the land of Canaan, and set them in a fortified city.
units.Ezekiel 17:5: He took some of the land’s seed and put it in the plain, a plant beside abundant water; he appointed it to be watched over.
units.Ezekiel 17:6: It sprouted and became a weak vine, small in size so that it might appear. Its branches were upon it and its roots beneath it. It became a vine, produced offshoots and extended its climbing growth.
units.Ezekiel 17:7: There was another great eagle, with great wings and many talons. Behold, this vine was intertwined toward him, its roots toward him; it sent its branches to him to water it together with the clod of its planting.
units.Ezekiel 17:8: It grows fat in a good plain beside abundant water, to produce shoots, bear fruit and become a great vine.
units.Ezekiel 17:9: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Will it prosper? Will not the roots of its tender growth and its fruit rot, and all its early shoots dry up? No great arm or numerous people will be needed to pull it from its roots.
units.Ezekiel 17:10: Behold, it grows fat—surely it will not prosper? Will it not dry up completely as soon as the scorching wind touches it? It will dry up together with the clod of its growth.’”
units.Ezekiel 17:11: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 17:12: “Son of man, say now to the embittering house, ‘Do you not understand what these things were?’ Say, ‘When Babylon’s king comes against Jerusalem, he will take her king and her rulers and bring them to himself in Babylon.
units.Ezekiel 17:13: He will take one of the royal seed, make a covenant with him, and bring him under a curse-oath. He will take the land’s leaders,
units.Ezekiel 17:14: so that it may become a weak kingdom, not exalt itself at all, and keep his covenant and establish it.
units.Ezekiel 17:15: He will revolt from him, sending his messengers to Egypt to give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will the one doing contrary things be rescued? Will one transgressing a covenant be saved?
units.Ezekiel 17:16: As I live, says the Lord, surely in the place of the king who made him king—he who dishonored My curse-oath and transgressed My covenant—with him in the midst of Babylon he will die.
units.Ezekiel 17:17: Pharaoh will not wage war against him with great power or a numerous crowd, amid siegeworks and the building of missile stations to remove lives.
units.Ezekiel 17:18: He dishonored a sworn oath by transgressing a covenant; behold, he has given his hand and did all these things to him. Surely he will not be saved?
units.Ezekiel 17:19: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: As I live, surely My covenant that he transgressed and My sworn oath that he dishonored—I will bring them upon his head.
units.Ezekiel 17:20: I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in his enclosure.
units.Ezekiel 17:21: In all his battle array they will fall by the sword, and I will scatter the survivors to every wind. You will recognize that I, the Lord, have spoken.’
units.Ezekiel 17:22: For thus says the Lord: I Myself will take from the cedar’s choice parts, nip off from the top of their heart, and I Myself will plant it upon a high mountain. I will suspend it
units.Ezekiel 17:23: upon Israel’s lofty mountain and plant it. It will produce a shoot, bear fruit and become a great cedar. Every beast will rest beneath it, every bird will rest under its shade, and its branches will be restored.
units.Ezekiel 17:24: All the plain’s trees will know that I am the Lord who lowers a high tree, raises a low tree, dries a green tree and makes a dry tree flourish. I, the Lord, have spoken and will act.”
units.Ezekiel 18:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 18:2: “Son of man, what is this proverb you have among Israel’s sons, saying, ‘The fathers ate unripe grapes, and the children’s teeth were set on edge’?
units.Ezekiel 18:3: As I live, says the Lord, this proverb will certainly no longer be spoken in Israel.
units.Ezekiel 18:4: For all souls are Mine. As the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son—they are Mine. The soul that sins will die.
units.Ezekiel 18:5: The person who is righteous, practicing judgment and righteousness,
units.Ezekiel 18:6: will not eat upon the mountains, certainly will not raise his eyes to the reflections of the house of Israel, certainly will not defile his neighbor’s wife, and will not approach a woman in her menstrual separation;
units.Ezekiel 18:7: he certainly will not oppress anyone, will return a debtor’s pledge, takes no plunder, will give his bread to the hungry, and will clothe the naked;
units.Ezekiel 18:8: he will not give his silver at interest or take increase, will turn his hand from injustice, and will render a righteous judgment between a man and his neighbor;
units.Ezekiel 18:9: he has walked in My commands and kept My ordinances to carry them out. This one is righteous; he will surely live, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 18:10: But if he fathers a pestilent son who sheds blood and commits sins,
units.Ezekiel 18:11: he did not walk in the way of his righteous father, but even ate upon the mountains and defiled his neighbor’s wife,
units.Ezekiel 18:12: oppressed the poor and needy, seized plunder, did not return a pledge, set his eyes upon idols, and has committed lawlessness,
units.Ezekiel 18:13: gave at interest and took increase—this one certainly will not live. He committed all this lawlessness; he will surely be put to death, and his blood will be upon him.
units.Ezekiel 18:14: But if he fathers a son who sees all the sins his father committed, becomes afraid, and does not act according to them,
units.Ezekiel 18:15: he has not eaten upon the mountains, not set his eyes upon the reflections of the house of Israel, and not defiled his neighbor’s wife,
units.Ezekiel 18:16: has not oppressed anyone, not taken a pledge, and not seized plunder; he gave his bread to the hungry and clothed the naked,
units.Ezekiel 18:17: and turned his hand from injustice, did not take interest or increase, practiced righteousness and walked in My commands. He will not die in his father’s injustices; he will surely live.
units.Ezekiel 18:18: But if his father practiced affliction and seized plunder, he did contrary things in the midst of My people and will die in his injustice.
units.Ezekiel 18:19: You will say, ‘Why did the son not receive his father’s injustice?’ Because the son practiced righteousness and mercy, preserved all My ordinances and carried them out; he will surely live.
units.Ezekiel 18:20: The soul that sins will die. The son will not receive his father’s injustice, nor the father his son’s injustice. The righteous person’s righteousness will be upon him, and the lawless person’s lawlessness upon him.
units.Ezekiel 18:21: If the lawless person turns from all the lawlessness he committed, keeps all My commandments, and practices righteousness and mercy, he will surely live; he certainly will not die.
units.Ezekiel 18:22: None of the transgressions he committed will be remembered. By the righteousness he practiced, he will live.
units.Ezekiel 18:23: Do I at all desire the death of the lawless, says the Lord, rather than his turning from his evil way and living?
units.Ezekiel 18:24: But when a righteous person turns from his righteousness and practices injustice according to all the lawlessness the lawless person committed, none of the righteous acts he did will be remembered. In the transgression he committed and the sins he sinned, in these he will die.
units.Ezekiel 18:25: You said, ‘The Lord’s way does not run straight.’ Hear now, the whole house of Israel: Surely My way does not fail to run straight? Is it not your way that fails to run straight?
units.Ezekiel 18:26: When the righteous person turns from his righteousness, commits a transgression and dies, in the transgression he committed—in it he will die.
units.Ezekiel 18:27: When a lawless person turns from the lawlessness he practiced and practices judgment and righteousness, this one has preserved his life
units.Ezekiel 18:28: and turned from all the impieties he committed; he will surely live, he certainly will not die.
units.Ezekiel 18:29: The house of Israel says, ‘The Lord’s way does not go right.’ Surely My way does not fail to go right, house of Israel? Is it not your way that fails to go right?
units.Ezekiel 18:30: I will judge you, each according to his way, house of Israel, says the Lord. Turn back and turn away from all your impieties, and they will not become a punishment of injustice for you.
units.Ezekiel 18:31: Cast away from yourselves all your impieties with which you acted impiously against Me, and make yourselves a new heart and a new spirit. Why are you dying, house of Israel?
units.Ezekiel 18:32: For I do not desire the death of the one who dies, says the Lord.”
units.Ezekiel 19:1: “And you, take up a lament over Israel’s ruler,
units.Ezekiel 19:2: and say: What was your mother? A cub! She came to be among lions; among lions she multiplied her cubs.
units.Ezekiel 19:3: One of her cubs sprang away; he became a lion, learned to seize prey, and ate human beings.
units.Ezekiel 19:4: Nations heard against him; he was caught in their destruction, and they led him with a muzzle to Egypt’s land.
units.Ezekiel 19:5: She saw that he had been driven away from her and that her support had perished; she took another of her cubs and appointed him a lion.
units.Ezekiel 19:6: He moved among lions, became a lion, learned to seize prey, and ate human beings.
units.Ezekiel 19:7: He fed in his boldness, desolated their cities, and destroyed the land and its fullness by the sound of his roaring.
units.Ezekiel 19:8: Nations from the surrounding countries set themselves against him and spread their nets over him; he was caught in their destruction.
units.Ezekiel 19:9: They put him in a muzzle and a cage. He came to Babylon’s king, and he brought him into prison, so that his voice would not be heard upon Israel’s mountains.
units.Ezekiel 19:10: Your mother was like a vine, like a blossom on a pomegranate tree, planted by water; her fruit and her shoot came from abundant water.
units.Ezekiel 19:11: She had a rod of strength for a tribe of leaders; it rose in her size among the trunks, and it saw her size among the multitude of her branches.
units.Ezekiel 19:12: She was broken off in wrath and thrown to the ground. The scorching wind dried her choice parts; her rod of strength was punished and dried up. Fire consumed her.
units.Ezekiel 19:13: Now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a waterless land,
units.Ezekiel 19:14: and fire went out from a rod of her choice parts and devoured her, and there was no rod of strength in her. A tribe is for a parable of lament, and it will become a lament.”
units.Ezekiel 20:1: In the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth of the month, men from the elders of the house of Israel came to question the Lord and sat before me.
units.Ezekiel 20:2: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 20:3: “Son of man, speak to Israel’s elders and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Have you come to question Me? As I live, I will certainly not answer you, says the Lord.’
units.Ezekiel 20:4: Shall I indeed exact retribution upon them? Son of man, solemnly testify to them about their fathers’ lawlessness,
units.Ezekiel 20:5: and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: From the day I chose the house of Israel, I became known to the seed of Jacob’s house and was known to them in Egypt’s land. I supported them with My hand, saying, “I am the Lord your God.”
units.Ezekiel 20:6: On that day I supported them with My hand to bring them out of Egypt’s land into the land I prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey; it is a honeycomb compared with all the earth.
units.Ezekiel 20:7: I said to them, “Let each cast away the abominations of his eyes, and do not be defiled by Egypt’s practices. I am the Lord your God.”
units.Ezekiel 20:8: They revolted from Me and would not listen to Me. They did not cast away the abominations of their eyes or abandon Egypt’s practices. I said I would pour My wrath upon them and complete My anger in them in the midst of Egypt’s land.
units.Ezekiel 20:9: I acted so that My name would not be profaned at all before the nations among whom they are, among whom I was known to them before their eyes by bringing them out of Egypt’s land.
units.Ezekiel 20:10: I brought them out of Egypt’s land and brought them into the wilderness,
units.Ezekiel 20:11: and gave them My commands and made My ordinances known to them, which a person will carry out and by which he will live.
units.Ezekiel 20:12: I gave them My sabbaths as a sign between Me and them, so that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
units.Ezekiel 20:13: I said to the house of Israel in the wilderness, “Walk in My commands.” But they did not walk, and they rejected My ordinances, which a person will carry out and by which he will live; they greatly profaned My sabbaths. I said I would pour My wrath upon them in the wilderness to consume them utterly.
units.Ezekiel 20:14: I acted so that My name would not be profaned at all before the nations from whom I brought them out before their eyes.
units.Ezekiel 20:15: I too raised My hand against them in the wilderness, that I would not bring them at all into the land I gave them, a land flowing with milk and honey, a honeycomb compared with all the earth,
units.Ezekiel 20:16: because they rejected My ordinances, did not walk in My commands, and were profaning My sabbaths, and they followed the reflections of their hearts.
units.Ezekiel 20:17: My eye spared them from obliteration, and I did not make a complete end of them in the wilderness.
units.Ezekiel 20:18: I said to their children in the wilderness, “Do not walk in your fathers’ ordinances, do not keep their judgments, do not mix yourselves with their practices, and do not be defiled.
units.Ezekiel 20:19: I am the Lord your God. Walk in My commands, keep My ordinances and carry them out,
units.Ezekiel 20:20: and sanctify My sabbaths; let it be a sign between Me and you, so that you may know that I am the Lord your God.”
units.Ezekiel 20:21: Their children too embittered Me. They did not walk in My commands or keep My ordinances to carry them out, which a person will carry out and by which he will live; they were profaning My sabbaths. I said I would pour My wrath upon them in the wilderness and complete My anger upon them.
units.Ezekiel 20:22: I acted so that My name would not be profaned at all before the nations from whom I brought them out before their eyes.
units.Ezekiel 20:23: I raised My hand against them in the wilderness, to scatter them among the nations and disperse them among the countries,
units.Ezekiel 20:24: because they did not carry out My ordinances, rejected My commands and were profaning My sabbaths, while their eyes followed their fathers’ reflections.
units.Ezekiel 20:25: I too gave them commands that were not good, and ordinances in which they would not live.
units.Ezekiel 20:26: I will defile them through their gifts, when I pass through every one who opens the womb, so that I may destroy them.
units.Ezekiel 20:27: Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: To this extent your fathers angered Me in the transgressions they committed against Me.
units.Ezekiel 20:28: I brought them into the land I raised My hand to give them. They saw every high hill and every shady tree; there they sacrificed to their gods, there they set a fragrant aroma, and there they poured their libations.
units.Ezekiel 20:29: I said to them, “What is Abama, that you go in there?” They called its name Abama to this very day.’
units.Ezekiel 20:30: Therefore say to the house of Israel, ‘Thus says the Lord: Are you being defiled in your fathers’ lawlessness and prostituting yourselves after their abominations?
units.Ezekiel 20:31: In the firstfruits of your gifts, in your separations, you are being defiled with all your reflections to this very day. Shall I answer you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord, I will certainly not answer you, nor will this rise upon your spirit.
units.Ezekiel 20:32: It will not be as you say: “We will be like the nations and like the tribes of the earth, serving woods and stones.”
units.Ezekiel 20:33: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, with a mighty hand, a high arm and outpoured wrath I will reign over you.
units.Ezekiel 20:34: I will bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries where you were scattered, with a mighty hand, a high arm and outpoured wrath.
units.Ezekiel 20:35: I will bring you into the wilderness of the peoples and contend with you there, face to face.
units.Ezekiel 20:36: As I contended with your fathers in the wilderness of Egypt’s land, so I will judge you, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 20:37: I will lead you beneath My rod and bring you in by number,
units.Ezekiel 20:38: and select from you the impious and those who have revolted, for I will bring them out of their sojourning, but they will not enter Israel’s land. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 20:39: And you, house of Israel, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Each of you, remove his practices! After these things, if you are not listening to Me, you will no longer profane My holy name with your gifts and practices.
units.Ezekiel 20:40: For upon My holy mountain, upon a high mountain, says the Lord, the Lord, there the whole house of Israel will serve Me to the end. There I will accept, and there I will attend to your firstfruits and the firstfruits of your separations, with all your holy things.
units.Ezekiel 20:41: As a fragrant aroma I will accept you when I bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries where you were scattered. I will be sanctified among you before the eyes of the peoples.
units.Ezekiel 20:42: You will recognize that I am the Lord when I bring you into Israel’s land, into the land for which I raised My hand to give it to your fathers.
units.Ezekiel 20:43: There you will remember your ways and your practices by which you were being defiled; you will beat your faces over all your evils.
units.Ezekiel 20:44: You will recognize that I am the Lord when I deal thus with you so that My name may not be profaned according to your evil ways and corrupt practices, says the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 21:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 21:2: “Son of man, set your face firmly toward Thaiman, look toward Darom, and prophesy against the leading forest, Nageb,
units.Ezekiel 21:3: and say to the Nageb forest, ‘Hear the Lord’s word! Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am kindling a fire within you. It will devour every green tree and every dry tree in you. The kindled flame will not be quenched, and every face from east to north will be burned by it.
units.Ezekiel 21:4: All flesh will recognize that I, the Lord, have kindled it, and it will not be quenched.’”
units.Ezekiel 21:5: I said, “By no means, Lord, Lord! They say to me, ‘Is this not a parable being spoken?’”
units.Ezekiel 21:6: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 21:7: “Therefore prophesy, son of man; set your face firmly toward Jerusalem, look toward their holy places, and prophesy against Israel’s land,
units.Ezekiel 21:8: and say to Israel’s land, ‘Behold, I am against you. I will draw My dagger from its sheath and destroy from you the unjust and the lawless.
units.Ezekiel 21:9: Because I will destroy from you the unjust and the lawless, so My dagger will come out of its sheath against all flesh from east to north.
units.Ezekiel 21:10: All flesh will recognize that I, the Lord, have drawn My dagger from its sheath, and it will not return again.’
units.Ezekiel 21:11: And you, son of man, groan deeply with your loins broken; groan in pains before their eyes.
units.Ezekiel 21:12: If they say to you, ‘Why are you groaning?’ say, ‘Because of the message, for it is coming. Every heart will be shattered, all hands will be paralyzed, all flesh and every spirit will expire, and all thighs will be defiled with moisture. Behold, it is coming and will happen, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 21:13: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 21:14: “Son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Say: Sword, sword, be sharpened and enraged,
units.Ezekiel 21:15: so that you may slaughter victims. Be sharpened to become gleaming. Ready for paralysis, slaughter! Disdain; thrust away every tree.
units.Ezekiel 21:16: He gave it ready for his hand to grasp. The sword has been sharpened; it is ready to be put into the hand of one who pierces.
units.Ezekiel 21:17: Cry aloud and wail, son of man, for it has come among My people, among all Israel’s leaders. They will sojourn upon a sword; it has come among My people. Therefore strike upon your hand.
units.Ezekiel 21:18: For it has been justified. And what if even a tribe was rejected? It will not be, says the Lord, the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 21:19: And you, son of man, prophesy and strike hand upon hand, and double the sword. The third sword of the wounded is the great sword of the wounded, and it will terrify them,
units.Ezekiel 21:20: so that the heart is shattered and the weak multiply at every gate of theirs. They have been handed over as victims of a sword. It has been well prepared for slaughter, well prepared for gleaming.
units.Ezekiel 21:21: Pass through! Be sharpened on the right and on the left, wherever your face may be roused.
units.Ezekiel 21:22: I too will strike My hand against My hand and release My wrath. I, the Lord, have spoken.’”
units.Ezekiel 21:23: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 21:24: “And you, son of man, arrange two roads for Babylon’s king’s sword to enter. Both will come out from one country, and a hand at the beginning of a city road; at the beginning
units.Ezekiel 21:25: of a road you will arrange for the sword to enter against Rabbath of the sons of Ammon, against Judea, and against Jerusalem in her midst.
units.Ezekiel 21:26: For Babylon’s king will stand upon the ancient road, at the beginning of the two roads, to divine a divination, toss a rod, question the carved images and inspect a liver at his right.
units.Ezekiel 21:27: The oracle came against Jerusalem: to set a siege stake, open the mouth in a shout, raise the voice with a cry, set a siege stake against her gates, cast up a mound and build missile stations.
units.Ezekiel 21:28: He is to them like one divining a divination before them, and he himself recalls his injustices for remembrance.
units.Ezekiel 21:29: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you recalled your injustices when your impieties were revealed, so that your sins were seen in all your impieties and practices—because you recalled them, in these you will be captured.
units.Ezekiel 21:30: And you, profane, lawless leader of Israel, whose day has arrived in a season of injustice—an end!—
units.Ezekiel 21:31: thus says the Lord: You removed the tiara and put on the crown. This will not be such. You lowered the high and raised the low.
units.Ezekiel 21:32: Injustice, injustice I will make it! Nor will this be such until the one comes to whom it belongs, and I will hand it over to him.
units.Ezekiel 21:33: And you, son of man, prophesy and say, ‘Thus says the Lord concerning the sons of Ammon and their reproach.’ Say, ‘Sword, sword, drawn for victims and drawn for complete destruction, arise so that you may gleam,
units.Ezekiel 21:34: in your vain vision and your divining false things, to hand you over upon the necks of the wounded lawless, whose day has arrived in a season of injustice—an end!
units.Ezekiel 21:35: Turn back; do not lodge in this place where you were born. In your own land I will judge you
units.Ezekiel 21:36: and pour My anger upon you. I will blow upon you with the fire of My anger and hand you into the hands of barbarian men devising destruction.
units.Ezekiel 21:37: You will be food in fire; your blood will be in the midst of your land. There certainly will be no remembrance of you, for I, the Lord, have spoken.’”
units.Ezekiel 22:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 22:2: “And you, son of man, will you judge the city of bloodshed? Display all her lawless deeds to her,
units.Ezekiel 22:3: and say, ‘Thus says the Lord, the Lord: O city shedding blood within her so that her time may come, making reflections against herself to defile herself!
units.Ezekiel 22:4: Through their blood that you shed you have transgressed, and through your reflections that you made you were being defiled. You brought your days near and brought the season of your years. Therefore I have made you a reproach to the nations and a mockery to all the countries
units.Ezekiel 22:5: near you and far away from you. They will mock you: “Unclean, the famous one, abundant in lawless deeds!”
units.Ezekiel 22:6: Behold, the leaders of Israel’s house mingled themselves in you, each with his relatives, in order to shed blood.
units.Ezekiel 22:7: They reviled father and mother in you and dealt unjustly with the sojourner in you. They oppressed the orphan and widow in you.
units.Ezekiel 22:8: They despised My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths in you.
units.Ezekiel 22:9: Robbers are in you in order to shed blood in you. They ate upon the mountains in you; they committed unholy acts within you.
units.Ezekiel 22:10: They uncovered a father’s shame in you, and they violated a woman sitting apart in uncleanness in you.
units.Ezekiel 22:11: Each acted lawlessly with his neighbor’s wife; each defiled his daughter-in-law with impiety; each violated his sister, his father’s daughter, in you.
units.Ezekiel 22:12: They took gifts in you in order to shed blood; they took interest and increase in you. You brought your evil in oppression to its full completion, but you forgot Me, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 22:13: But if I strike My hand against My hand over what you have completed, what you did, and over your bloodshed that occurred within you,
units.Ezekiel 22:14: will your heart hold out? Will your hands prevail in the days when I act within you? I, the Lord, have spoken and will act.
units.Ezekiel 22:15: I will scatter you among the nations and disperse you among the countries, and your uncleanness will cease from you.
units.Ezekiel 22:16: I will take possession in you before the nations’ eyes, and you will know that I am the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 22:17: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 22:18: “Son of man, behold, Israel’s house has become mixed to Me, all of them with copper, iron, tin and lead; it is mixed amid silver.
units.Ezekiel 22:19: Therefore say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Because all of you became one mixture, therefore I am receiving you into Jerusalem.
units.Ezekiel 22:20: As silver, copper, iron, tin and lead are received into a furnace to blow fire into it to melt it, so I will receive you in My anger, gather you and melt you,
units.Ezekiel 22:21: and blow upon you with the fire of My anger, and you will be melted within her.
units.Ezekiel 22:22: As silver is melted within a furnace, so you will be melted within her. You will recognize that I, the Lord, have poured My wrath upon you.’”
units.Ezekiel 22:23: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 22:24: “Son of man, say to her, ‘You are a land not wetted, nor did rain come upon you on the day of wrath.
units.Ezekiel 22:25: Her leaders within her are like roaring lions seizing prey, devouring lives with power, taking payments unjustly, and your widows have multiplied within you.
units.Ezekiel 22:26: Her priests set aside My law and profaned My holy things. They did not distinguish between holy and profane, nor distinguish between unclean and clean. They covered their eyes from My Sabbaths, and I was profaned among them.
units.Ezekiel 22:27: Her rulers within her are like wolves seizing prey to shed blood, so that in greed they may gain more.
units.Ezekiel 22:28: Her prophets, coating them, will fall, seeing vain things, divining falsehoods, saying, “Thus says the Lord,” when the Lord has not spoken,
units.Ezekiel 22:29: oppressing the people of the land unjustly and seizing plunder, oppressing the poor and needy and not dealing justly with the sojourner.
units.Ezekiel 22:30: I sought among them a man conducting himself rightly and standing wholly before Me at the land’s time, so that I would not utterly wipe her out, but I found none.
units.Ezekiel 22:31: I poured My wrath upon her in the fire of My anger to bring an end. I brought their ways upon their own heads, says the Lord, the Lord.’”
units.Ezekiel 23:1: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 23:2: “Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother,
units.Ezekiel 23:3: and they prostituted themselves in Egypt in their youth. There their breasts fell; there they were deflowered.
units.Ezekiel 23:4: Their names were Oholah the elder and Oholibah her sister. They became Mine and bore sons and daughters. Their names: Samaria is Oholah, and Jerusalem is Oholibah.
units.Ezekiel 23:5: Oholah prostituted herself away from Me and set her desire upon her lovers, the Assyrians approaching her,
units.Ezekiel 23:6: clothed in blue-purple, leaders and generals; all choice young men, horsemen riding horses.
units.Ezekiel 23:7: She bestowed her prostitution upon them, all choice sons of Assyrians; and with all upon whom she set her desire, in all her reflections she was defiled.
units.Ezekiel 23:8: She did not abandon her prostitution from Egypt, for they lay with her in her youth; they deflowered her and poured their prostitution upon her.
units.Ezekiel 23:9: Therefore I handed her into her lovers’ hands, into the hands of Assyrians’ sons, upon whom she had set her desire.
units.Ezekiel 23:10: They uncovered her shame, took her sons and daughters, and killed her with the sword. She became a subject of talk among women, and they inflicted punishments upon her, upon the daughters.
units.Ezekiel 23:11: Her sister Oholibah saw this and corrupted her desire beyond hers, and her prostitution beyond her sister’s prostitution.
units.Ezekiel 23:12: She set her desire upon Assyrians’ sons, leaders and generals near her, clothed in finely bordered garments, horsemen riding horses; all choice young men.
units.Ezekiel 23:13: I saw that she was defiled; one way for the two.
units.Ezekiel 23:14: She added to her prostitution and saw men depicted upon the wall, images of Chaldeans drawn with a stylus,
units.Ezekiel 23:15: girded with embroidered work at their waists, with dyed tiaras upon their heads, all with a threefold appearance, the likeness of Chaldeans’ sons from their native land.
units.Ezekiel 23:16: She set her desire upon them at the sight of her eyes and sent messengers to them in the Chaldeans’ land.
units.Ezekiel 23:17: Babylon’s sons came to her, to a bed of lodgers, and defiled her in her prostitution. She was defiled by them, and her soul withdrew from them.
units.Ezekiel 23:18: She uncovered her prostitution and uncovered her shame. My soul withdrew from her, as My soul had withdrawn from her sister.
units.Ezekiel 23:19: You multiplied your prostitution to recall the days of your youth, in which you prostituted yourself in Egypt,
units.Ezekiel 23:20: and you set your desire upon the Chaldeans, whose flesh was like donkeys’ and whose genitals were horses’ genitals.
units.Ezekiel 23:21: You revisited the lawlessness of your youth, what you did in Egypt at your lodging, where your youthful breasts were.
units.Ezekiel 23:22: Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord: Behold, I am rousing your lovers against you, those from whom your soul withdrew. I will bring them against you all around:
units.Ezekiel 23:23: Babylon’s sons and all the Chaldeans, Phakoud, Soue and Koue, and all Assyrians’ sons with them, choice young men, all leaders and generals, threefold men and renowned men riding horses.
units.Ezekiel 23:24: All will come against you from the north: chariots and wheels with a multitude of peoples, large shields and small shields; they will set a guard against you all around. I will set judgment before them, and they will punish you by their judgments.
units.Ezekiel 23:25: I will set My jealousy within you, and they will deal with you in fierce anger. They will remove your nose and ears and strike down your remaining people with the sword. They will take your sons and daughters, and fire will consume your remaining people.
units.Ezekiel 23:26: They will strip you of your clothing and take the objects of your boasting.
units.Ezekiel 23:27: I will turn your impieties away from you and your prostitution from Egypt’s land. You certainly will not lift your eyes toward them, and you certainly will no longer remember Egypt.
units.Ezekiel 23:28: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am handing you into the hands of those you hate, those from whom your soul withdrew.
units.Ezekiel 23:29: They will deal with you in hatred and take all the fruit of your pain and toil. You will be naked and exposed to shame, and the shame of your prostitution and your impiety will be uncovered. Your prostitution
units.Ezekiel 23:30: did these things to you when you prostituted yourself after nations and were defiled in their reflections.
units.Ezekiel 23:31: You walked in your sister’s way; I will put her cup into your hands.
units.Ezekiel 23:32: Thus says the Lord: You will drink your sister’s cup, deep and wide, abounding to bring about
units.Ezekiel 23:33: drunkenness; you will be filled with collapse. And the cup of annihilation, your sister Samaria’s cup—
units.Ezekiel 23:34: you will drink it. I will turn away her festivals and her new moons, for I have spoken, says the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 23:35: Therefore thus says the Lord: Because you forgot Me and cast Me behind your body, you too must take your impiety and your prostitution.”
units.Ezekiel 23:36: The Lord said to me, “Son of man, will you not judge Oholah and Oholibah? Declare their lawless deeds to them,
units.Ezekiel 23:37: for they committed adultery, and blood is on their hands. They committed adultery with their reflections, and made their children whom they bore to Me pass through fire offerings for them.
units.Ezekiel 23:38: They even did these things to Me: they defiled My holy things and profaned My Sabbaths.
units.Ezekiel 23:39: When they slaughtered their children for their idols, they entered My holy places to profane them. Indeed, they acted this way within My house.
units.Ezekiel 23:40: Indeed, for the men coming from far away, to whom they sent messengers—as soon as they arrived, you immediately bathed, painted your eyes with antimony and adorned yourself with ornaments,
units.Ezekiel 23:41: and sat upon a spread couch with an adorned table before it. My incense and My oil—they delighted in them.
units.Ezekiel 23:42: They struck up a harmonious sound. With men arriving from the mass of people out of the wilderness, they gave bracelets for their hands and a crown of boasting upon their heads.
units.Ezekiel 23:43: I said, ‘Do they not commit adultery in these things? A prostitute’s deeds—and she herself prostituted herself!’
units.Ezekiel 23:44: They entered her as they enter a prostitute; so they entered Oholah and Oholibah to commit lawlessness.
units.Ezekiel 23:45: Righteous men will punish them with the punishment of an adulteress and the punishment of bloodshed, for they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands.
units.Ezekiel 23:46: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Bring a multitude against them and set turmoil and plunder among them,
units.Ezekiel 23:47: and stone them with the multitude’s stones and pierce them with their swords. They will kill their sons and daughters and burn their houses.
units.Ezekiel 23:48: I will turn impiety away from the land. All women will be disciplined and certainly will not act according to their impieties.
units.Ezekiel 23:49: Your impiety will be brought upon you, and you will receive the sins of your reflections. You will know that I am the Lord.”
units.Ezekiel 24:1: The Lord’s word came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
units.Ezekiel 24:2: “Son of man, write for yourself a record of the day, from this day on which Babylon’s king pressed against Jerusalem, from this present day,
units.Ezekiel 24:3: and speak a parable against the provoking house. Say to them, ‘Thus says the Lord: Set on the cauldron and pour water into it,
units.Ezekiel 24:4: and put the cut pieces into it, every good cut, leg and shoulder stripped from the bones,
units.Ezekiel 24:5: from choice animals taken. Burn the bones beneath them. It boiled, it boiled, and her bones have been cooked within her.
units.Ezekiel 24:6: Therefore thus says the Lord: O city of bloodshed! A cauldron with rust in it, whose rust has not come out of her! He brought it out limb by limb; no lot fell upon her.
units.Ezekiel 24:7: For her blood is within her. I have set it upon smooth rock; I have not poured it upon the earth to cover it with earth.
units.Ezekiel 24:8: To make wrath rise for vengeance to be exacted, I have set her blood upon smooth rock so that it will not be covered.
units.Ezekiel 24:9: Therefore thus says the Lord: I too will enlarge the firebrand
units.Ezekiel 24:10: and multiply the wood and kindle the fire, so that the flesh melts and the broth is reduced,
units.Ezekiel 24:11: and it stands upon the coals, so that its copper is scorched and heated and melts amid its uncleanness, and its rust ceases,
units.Ezekiel 24:12: yet her abundant rust certainly will not leave her; her rust will be put to shame,
units.Ezekiel 24:13: because you were being defiled. And what if you are not cleansed any more until I fill up My wrath?
units.Ezekiel 24:14: I, the Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will act. I will not draw back, nor will I show mercy. According to your ways and your reflections I will judge you, says the Lord. Therefore I will judge you according to your bloodshed, and according to your reflections I will judge you, the unclean one, the famous one, abundant in provoking.’”
units.Ezekiel 24:15: The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 24:16: “Son of man, behold, I am taking the desires of your eyes from you in battle array. You certainly will not beat your breast, nor be wept over.
units.Ezekiel 24:17: It is a groaning of blood, of loins, of mourning. Your hair will not be plaited upon you, nor will your footwear be on your feet. You certainly will not be comforted by their lips or eat the bread of men.
units.Ezekiel 24:18: I spoke to the people in the morning as He commanded me, and my wife died in the evening. In the morning I did as I was ordered.
units.Ezekiel 24:19: The people said to me, “Will you not tell us what these things are that you are doing?”
units.Ezekiel 24:20: I said to them, “The Lord’s word came to me, saying,
units.Ezekiel 24:21: ‘Say to Israel’s house, Thus says the Lord: Behold, I am profaning My holy things, the boast of your strength, the desires of your eyes, those for whom your souls care. Your sons and daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword.
units.Ezekiel 24:22: You will do as I have done: you will not be comforted from their mouth or eat the bread of men,
units.Ezekiel 24:23: with your hair upon your heads and your footwear on your feet. You certainly will neither beat your breasts nor weep; you will waste away in your injustices and each will comfort his brother.
units.Ezekiel 24:24: Ezekiel will be a portent for you; according to everything he has done, you will do when these things come. You will recognize that I am the Lord.
units.Ezekiel 24:25: And you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take their strength from them, the exaltation of their boasting, the desires of their eyes, the exaltation of their soul, their sons and daughters—
units.Ezekiel 24:26: on that day the survivor will come to you to announce it into your ears?
units.Ezekiel 24:27: On that day your mouth will be opened toward the survivor; you will speak and certainly will no longer be struck mute. You will be a portent for them, and they will recognize that I am the Lord.’”
units.Obadiah 1:1: The vision of Obadiah. Thus says the Lord God to Idumea: I heard a report from the Lord, and He sent a dispatch to the nations: “Rise up! Let us rise against her for battle!”
units.Obadiah 1:2: Look, I have made you insignificant among the nations; you are greatly dishonored.
units.Obadiah 1:3: The pride of your heart has lifted you up, you who camp in holes in the rocks, raising his dwelling high and saying in his heart, “Who will bring me down to the ground?”
units.Obadiah 1:4: If you soar like an eagle, and if you place your nest among the stars, from there I will bring you down, says the Lord.
units.Obadiah 1:5: If thieves came in to you, or robbers by night, where would you have been cast away? Would they not have stolen enough for themselves? And if grape gatherers came in to you, would they not have left a gleaning?
units.Obadiah 1:6: How Esau has been searched out, and his hidden things seized!
units.Obadiah 1:7: All the men of your covenant sent you out as far as your borders; the men at peace with you opposed you and prevailed over you. They set ambushes beneath you. There is no understanding in them.
units.Obadiah 1:8: On that day, says the Lord, I will destroy the wise from Idumea and understanding from Mount Esau.
units.Obadiah 1:9: Your warriors from Teman will be terrified, so that a person may be removed from Mount Esau,
units.Obadiah 1:10: because of the slaughter and the impiety toward your brother Jacob; and shame will cover you, and you will be removed forever.
units.Obadiah 1:11: From the day you stood opposed, on the day foreigners took his strength captive and strangers entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.
units.Obadiah 1:12: Do not look on your brother’s day, on the day of strangers; do not rejoice over the sons of Judah on the day of their destruction; do not speak boastfully on the day of affliction.
units.Obadiah 1:13: Do not enter the gates of peoples on the day of their suffering. You, too, must not look on their assembly on the day of their destruction, and do not join in attacking their strength on the day of their destruction.
units.Obadiah 1:14: Do not stand at their escape routes to destroy those of them who are being saved, and do not shut in those fleeing from them on the day of affliction.
units.Obadiah 1:15: For the day of the Lord is near against all the nations. Just as you acted, so it will be for you; your recompense will be repaid upon your own head.
units.Obadiah 1:16: For just as you drank on My holy mountain, all the nations will drink wine; they will drink and go down, and they will be as though they did not exist.
units.Obadiah 1:17: But on Mount Zion there will be salvation, and it will be holy; the house of Jacob will possess those who possessed them.
units.Obadiah 1:18: The house of Jacob will be a fire, the house of Joseph a flame, and the house of Esau stubble. They will blaze against them and consume them, and there will be no bearer of fire in the house of Esau, because the Lord has spoken.
units.Obadiah 1:19: Those in the Negeb will possess the mountain of Esau, and those in the Shephelah will possess the foreigners. They will possess the mountain of Ephraim, the plain of Samaria, Benjamin and the land of Gilead.
units.Obadiah 1:20: And this is the beginning of the deportation: for the sons of Israel, the land of the Canaanites as far as Zarephath; and the deportation of Jerusalem as far as Ephrathah. They will inherit the cities of the Negeb.
units.Obadiah 1:21: And men who have been saved shall ascend from Mount Zion to execute judgment upon the mountain of Esau; and the kingdom shall be the Lord’s.
units.Genesis 36:1: And these are the generations of Esau, who is Edom.
units.Genesis 36:2: And Esau took wives from the daughters of the Canaanites: Adah the daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah the son of Zibeon the Hivite,
units.Genesis 36:3: and Basemath the daughter of Ishmael, the sister of Nebaioth.
units.Genesis 36:4: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel.
units.Genesis 36:5: And Oholibamah bore Jeush and Jalam and Korah. These are Esau’s sons who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
units.Genesis 36:6: And Esau took his wives and his sons and his daughters, and all the persons of his house, and all his possessions and all his livestock, and all that he had acquired and all that he had gained in the land of Canaan; and he went out from the land of Canaan, away from the presence of Jacob his brother.
units.Genesis 36:7: For their possessions were too great for them to live together, and the land of their sojourning could not support them because of the multitude of their possessions.
units.Genesis 36:8: And Esau lived in the mountain of Seir; Esau is Edom.
units.Genesis 36:9: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of Edom, in the mountain of Seir.
units.Isaiah 34:1: Draw near, nations, and hear, rulers! Let the earth and those in it hear, the inhabited world and the people in it!
units.Isaiah 34:2: For the Lord’s wrath is against all nations, and anger against their number, to destroy them and hand them over to slaughter.
units.Isaiah 34:3: Their wounded and dead will be thrown out; their odor will rise, and mountains will be soaked with their blood.
units.Isaiah 34:4: Heaven will roll up like a scroll, and all the stars will fall like leaves from a vine, like leaves falling from a fig tree.
units.Isaiah 34:5: My sword became drunk in heaven. Behold, it will descend upon Idumea and upon the people of destruction, with judgment.
units.Isaiah 34:6: The Lord’s sword was filled with blood, thickened with lambs’ fat and the fat of male goats and rams, for the Lord has a sacrifice in Bosor and a great slaughter in Idumea.
units.Isaiah 34:7: The stout ones will fall with them, and rams and bulls; the earth will become drunk with blood and be filled with their fat.
units.Isaiah 34:8: For it is the Lord’s day of judgment and a year of repayment for Zion’s judgment.
units.Isaiah 34:9: Her ravines will turn to pitch, her earth to sulfur, and her land will burn like pitch
units.Isaiah 34:10: night and day. It will not be quenched for an everlasting time, and her smoke will rise upward. For generations and a long time she will be deserted.
units.Isaiah 34:11: Birds, hedgehogs, ibises and ravens will dwell in her; a measuring cord for deserted land will be cast upon her, and donkey-centaurs will dwell in her.
units.Isaiah 34:12: Her rulers will be no more, for her kings, her rulers and her magnates will come to destruction.
units.Isaiah 34:13: Thorny trees will sprout in their cities and her fortifications; she will become a dwelling for sirens and a courtyard for ostriches.
units.Isaiah 34:14: Demons will meet donkey-centaurs and cry one to another. There donkey-centaurs will rest, for they found rest for themselves.
units.Isaiah 34:15: There a hedgehog nested, and the earth kept her children safe. There deer met and saw one another’s faces;
units.Isaiah 34:16: they passed by in number, and not one of them perished; none sought another, for the Lord commanded them and His spirit gathered them.
units.Isaiah 34:17: He Himself will cast lots for them, and His hand apportioned grazing. You will inherit for an everlasting time; for generations of generations they will rest upon her.
